comparison.objective: Transfer six crackers to a basket while excluding a desiccant packet; unlike commissioning a shock absorber through iterative adjustment and cycling.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated rigid-object selection and pick-place, not recessed-key engagement, collar tuning, relocking, or response-based calibration.
comparison.success_condition: All six crackers delivered; any packet entry permanently zeros score. No detailed grasp/drop thresholds stated. Candidate instead requires two safe, repeatable dynamic stops and verified lock retention.
comparison.reason: Semantic selection and transport test a meaningfully different ability from mechanical damping calibration.
